title: Test it
items:
Turn the knob slowly lock to lock. Both wheels turn the same way,
smoothly, without the tie rod catching on the arm studs.

Count the lock: roughly 30-35 degrees each way before a tyre touches
the frame rails or the axle beam.
Let go at full lock: the wheels should stay put, not spring back.

Press down firmly on the frame rails (about the weight of the cab).
The turntables should not tilt or wobble; wheels stay upright.
Roll it along the table: it runs straight when the knob is centred.

Note anything that binds, wobbles or pops off, and how far it steers.
A photo from below helps. We fix it before building the cab.
